summary: Added include_archived: z.boolean().optional().default(false) to ListProjectsSchema in project-lifecycle.ts.
Updated listProjects() to filter out ARCHIVED by default unless include_archived: true or an explicit status: 'ARCHIVED' filter is set.
Exposed listProjects via _internal for testability, accepting optional _ledgerRoot override parameter (consistent with completeSynthesis and initializeProject patterns).
Updated tool registration description to mention ARCHIVED and include_archived.
Updated detectProjectByCwd in ledger-store.ts to skip matches where meta.status === 'ARCHIVED'.
Updated ledger_list_projects help content in help-content.ts to document include_archived parameter and ARCHIVED status.
Created tests/tools/list-projects.test.ts with 6 tests covering all include_archived scenarios.
Added 2 ARCHIVED-skip tests to tests/storage/ledger-store.test.ts detectProjectByCwd suite.
All 38 test files, 1153 tests pass.

comments.note: listProjects in project-lifecycle.ts was not exported via _internal for testability. It is now added so unit tests can pass a custom _ledgerRoot. This pattern is already established by completeSynthesis and initializeProject.

The status filter in ListProjectsSchema still uses WorkPackageStatus (which now includes ARCHIVED through the ProjectStatus change), but the comment left by the original developer flagged this as a known tech-debt item. The new include_archived parameter is a cleaner additive addition that avoids exacerbating the debt.

summary: All 6 acceptance criteria verified against source code and test suite.
AC-1: project-lifecycle.ts:543-545 — when !args.include_archived and no explicit status filter, filtered.filter((p) => p.status !== 'ARCHIVED') is applied. ARCHIVED projects are excluded by default.

AC-2: When include_archived: true the `else if (!args.include_archived)` branch is skipped, so ARCHIVED projects remain in results. Also: when status: 'ARCHIVED' is explicitly set, the first branch applies status filter directly (takes precedence) — correct per AC.
AC-3: ledger-store.ts:529-530 — `if (meta.status === 'ARCHIVED') continue;` in detectProjectByCwd. Comment reads: 'Skip archived projects — agents should not accidentally work on them'.

AC-4: ledger_get_project_status reads root index by explicit project_path via LedgerStore, not through detectProjectByCwd. No change needed; archived projects remain accessible when addressed directly.

AC-5: help-content.ts:628-653 — ledger_list_projects help entry updated with a callout Note block, include_archived param documented with type and default, two examples ({include_archived: true} and {status: 'ARCHIVED'}).
AC-6: 39 test files, 1167 tests — all pass. 6 new tests in list-projects.test.ts, 2 ARCHIVED-skip tests added to ledger-store.test.ts detectProjectByCwd suite.

comments.note: Filter precedence is correctly implemented: explicit status filter takes precedence over include_archived. So status: 'ARCHIVED' alone returns only archived projects, overriding the default suppress. This edge case is documented in help-content and the tool description.

AC-4 (ledger_get_project_status works with explicit project_path for archived projects) is ensured by the fact that getProjectStatus reads by path directly — no changes were needed to that tool. The AC is implicitly covered by existing getProjectStatus tests and the detectProjectByCwd skip only applies to auto-detection. No dedicated test was added for this implicit guarantee. Low risk, but worth noting.

summary: Code review PASS. WP-004 implementation is architecturally sound, well-tested, and correctly scoped.

ListProjectsSchema gets include_archived: z.boolean().optional().default(false) with a .describe(). Correct Zod pattern; the default(false) makes the parameter optional at the call site without needing explicit handling.

Filter precedence is correct: explicit status filter takes precedence (first branch), ARCHIVED exclusion is else-if (only applies when no explicit status filter is set). The comment on line 544 documents this clearly.
detectProjectByCwd skip at ledger-store.ts:529-530 is minimal and readable — a single `if (meta.status === 'ARCHIVED') continue;` with a clear comment. No behavioral side effects on any other method.
Tool description updated to mention ARCHIVED and include_archived; help content updated with example and callout note. Both are clear and accurate.

6 new tests in list-projects.test.ts + 2 ARCHIVED-skip tests in ledger-store.test.ts. All scenarios covered: default exclusion, include_archived: true, status: 'ARCHIVED' explicit filter, and detectProjectByCwd skip.

comments.note: Filter logic correctly orders precedence: explicit `status:` filter branch runs first, `else if (!include_archived)` ARCHIVED exclusion runs only when no explicit status filter is set. The comment on line 544 documents this intent clearly. No issues.

detectProjectByCwd skip at ledger-store.ts:529-530 uses a readable `continue` with an inline comment — clear and idiomatic. The comment 'agents should not accidentally work on them' makes the intent unambiguous for future maintainers.

AC-4 (ledger_get_project_status works with explicit project_path for ARCHIVED) is guaranteed by architecture (getProjectStatus constructs LedgerStore directly without detectProjectByCwd). The implicit coverage is sound. A dedicated smoke test would make this guarantee explicit but is low priority given the clear architectural separation.
